notes.title: Bargue Playtest Access
notes.notes:
Hello,

On Monday, May 30, 2022, we are releasing the test version of our game for 200 people who will be selected randomly among those who apply for the Bargue Playtest version.

If you have not applied yet, now is the perfect time to apply ;)
You can request acces through the "Join the Bargue Playlist" section in the Bargue store page.

[b]Note:[/b] Remember, when the game's testing process is over, Bargue Playtest will be deleted from your Steam library. In order to continue playing Bargue, you must purchase the game after the release of the game.
